policy.identity: Material IDs remain distinct. Duplicate channels require matching RGBA8 bytes, dimensions, color space and baked filter.
policy.scalarFolding: Only exactly constant sampled roughness G or metalness B is replaced by its byte / 255 scalar; other maps remain textures.
policy.memory: Base-level and full-mip-chain RGBA8 texel estimates exclude driver overhead, compression and copies. Full mip chains are a separate estimate, not measured GPU memory or an assertion that every client enables mipmaps.
policy.cutouts: Alpha-test base-color maps remain textures. Audit records alphaTest but does not infer a no-mipmap policy from it.
